title: Amazon nears deal to buy Globalstar, Bloomberg News reports
title_zh: 据彭博社报道，亚马逊即将达成收购 Globalstar 的交易
summary: Amazon is in ‌advanced talks ‌to acquire satellite ​telecom group Globalstar, a deal that would bolster ‌the ⁠tech major's push to build ⁠its own satellite operation, ​Bloomberg ​News ​reported on ‌Monday.
summary_zh: 据彭博新闻周一报道，亚马逊正在就收购卫星电信集团 Globalstar 进行高级谈判，这笔交易将支持这家科技巨头建立自己的卫星运营业务。

title: Intel’s Tesla Chip Deal Is a Genuine Game Changer
title_zh: 英特尔的特斯拉芯片交易是真正的游戏规则改变者
summary: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) stock is currently in the midst of a historic win streak, and it’s grabbing the attention of everyday investors, some of whom may have been a bit quick to dismiss the lagging chip play way back when it was hovering in its multi-year depths.
summary_zh: 英特尔（纳斯达克股票代码：INTC）的股票目前正处于历史性的连涨之中，它吸引了普通投资者的注意力，其中一些人可能很快就忽视了落后的芯片市场，当时它徘徊在多年来的低谷。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures hold steady as US-Iran deal discussed
title_zh: 今日股市：随着美伊协议的讨论，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货保持稳定
summary: The major gauges held around the baseline as peace talks between Iran and the US were broached.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗和美国之间的和平谈判的展开，主要指标保持在基线附近。

title: Wall Street gains as investors hold out hope for a US-Iran deal
title_zh: 投资者对美伊协议抱有希望，华尔街上涨
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes rallied on Monday, with the Dow gaining more than six-tenths of a percent, the S&P 500 climbing 1% and the Nasdaq adding nearly one-and-a-quarter percent.After a muted start to the day, stocks picked up steam midday after President Donald Trum...
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周一上涨，道琼斯指数上涨逾十分之六，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1%，纳斯达克指数上涨近四分之一。

title: Bloom Energy Stock Jumps on Expanded Fuel Cell Deal for Oracle
title_zh: 甲骨文扩大燃料电池交易，Bloom Energy 股价上涨
summary: Bloom’s fuel cells will support Oracle projects in the U.S. amid demand for its AI and cloud-computing infrastructure.
summary_zh: Bloom 的燃料电池将支持 Oracle 在美国的项目，以满足对其人工智能和云计算基础设施的需求。
